strongest_angle: An Overview of Bank Failures in the United States and India in 2026

key_facts.fact: In 2026, there were 6 bank failures in the United States, with the most recent being Nano Banc, which closed on September 25, 2026.
The FDIC reported that the total number of bank failures in the United States from 1934 to 2026 is 3,526, sourced from the FDIC's failed-bank list.
In India, there were no bank failures reported in 2026, based on the available data.
